Control parameters of the sensible heat flux calibration

Source: R/metric-sensible-heat.R
ef_h_control.Rd

Builds and validates the settings of ef_calibrate_h(): the heights of the aerodynamic formulation, the height at which the stable stability correction for momentum of the blending height is evaluated (decision SH-11) and the convergence settings of the iteration.

Usage

ef_h_control(
  stable_psi_m_height = 2,
  blending_height = 200,
  z1 = 0.1,
  z2 = 2,
  tol = 0.01,
  maxit = 20L,
  damping = 0
)

Arguments

stable_psi_m_height

Numeric scalar. Height [m] at which the stability correction for momentum \(\psi_m\) of the blending height is evaluated under stable conditions (\(L > 0\)). Default 2 m, i.e. \(\psi_m(200\,m) = -5 \cdot 2/L\), as written in Waters et al. (2002), p. 33, Eq. 38 (decision SH-11, resolved). Another height may still be chosen explicitly, e.g. the blending height itself (stable_psi_m_height = 200, \(\psi_m = -5 \cdot 200/L\)); with \(L = 41.97\) m the two choices give -0.238 and -23.8. Under unstable conditions \(\psi_m\) is always evaluated at blending_height (Eqs. 35 and 37a). Must be finite, > 0 and <= blending_height.

blending_height

Numeric scalar. Blending height \(z_b\) [m]. Default 200 m (Waters et al., 2002, p. 26). Must be finite and greater than z2.

z1, z2

Numeric scalars. Lower and upper heights of the aerodynamic resistance [m], 0 < z1 < z2. Defaults 0.1 m and 2 m (Waters et al., 2002, p. 30 and Eq. 41).

tol

Numeric scalar. Convergence tolerance on the relative change of \(r_{ah}\) between iterations, applied to every anchor (phase A) and to every pixel (phase B). Must be > 0. Default 0.01 (decision P0-10; value of METRIC implementations, without a primary source). The value matters: in the synthetic case of the specification, tol = 0.01 stops 0.6 % away from the fixed point of the intercept.

maxit

Integer scalar. Maximum number of iterations, >= 1. Default 20 (P0-10; a design choice).

damping

Numeric scalar. Damping factor \(\omega\) in [0, 1), \(r_{ah,k} = (1 - \omega) r_{ah,new} + \omega r_{ah,k-1}\). Default 0 (P0-10). Damping does not change the fixed point; it can help when the iteration oscillates.

Value

A named list with elements stable_psi_m_height, blending_height, z1, z2, tol, maxit (integer) and damping.

Details

Invalid values raise earthflux_domain_error or earthflux_input_error (e.g. a stable_psi_m_height above the blending height, or z2 <= z1).

Why 2 m under stable conditions: the manual evaluates the stable correction of the momentum at the blending height with the ratio \(2/L\), not \(200/L\); the water package does the same. With a stable cold anchor (\(H < 0\), advection) the calibration converges with 2 m and diverges with 200 m in the synthetic scene of the specification (finding M2-07 of dev/DECISIONS.md).

Verification status: blending_height, z1, z2 and stable_psi_m_height = 2 are VERIFICADA (SEBAL-Idaho 2002) (Waters et al., 2002, pp. 26, 30 and 33, Eqs. 38-41); the cross-check with Allen, Tasumi and Trezza (2007) is desirable but no longer blocking (dev/VERIFICATION.md). tol, maxit and damping are design choices adopted provisionally (P0-10).

References

Waters, R., Allen, R., Bastiaanssen, W., Tasumi, M., & Trezza, R. (2002). SEBAL: Surface Energy Balance Algorithms for Land. Idaho implementation. Advanced training and users manual (Version 1.0). University of Idaho and Idaho Department of Water Resources.

See also

Other aerodynamics and sensible heat functions: ef_air_density(), ef_blending_wind(), ef_calibrate_h(), ef_dt_coef(), ef_rah(), ef_sensible_heat(), ef_ts_datum(), ef_ustar(), ef_zom()

Examples

# Defaults of the SEBAL Idaho manual (z_b = 200 m, z1 = 0.1 m, z2 = 2 m,
# stable psi_m of the blending height with 2 / L)
ef_h_control()
#> $stable_psi_m_height
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $blending_height
#> [1] 200
#> 
#> $z1
#> [1] 0.1
#> 
#> $z2
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $tol
#> [1] 0.01
#> 
#> $maxit
#> [1] 20
#> 
#> $damping
#> [1] 0
#> 

# The blending height in the stable correction, chosen explicitly
ef_h_control(stable_psi_m_height = 200)
#> $stable_psi_m_height
#> [1] 200
#> 
#> $blending_height
#> [1] 200
#> 
#> $z1
#> [1] 0.1
#> 
#> $z2
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $tol
#> [1] 0.01
#> 
#> $maxit
#> [1] 20
#> 
#> $damping
#> [1] 0
#>
